summary.text: Alan Wessman is an Unaffiliated candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 64, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Jackie Larson.
Wessman is a software engineer who, in a Ballotpedia survey, said he has lived in Spanish Fork for 20 years.

paragraphs.text: Wessman earned a high school diploma from W.F. West High School, a bachelor's degree from Brigham Young University in 1999, and a graduate degree from Brigham Young University in 2005.
His career experience includes working as a software engineer.
In 2022, Wessman ran for District 64 as a United Utah Party candidate and received 2,761 votes (20.0%) to incumbent Jefferson Burton's 11,044 (80.0%).

In a Ballotpedia survey, Wessman described himself as a husband, father and new grandfather, and said he decided to run when he realized the seat would be unopposed and voters would have no meaningful choice.
He said he wants to conserve water, air and scenery for future generations and to hold abusers accountable when abuses happen.
